checks.result: SND@LHC upgrade and symplectic-double-code paper selected; routine meetings, awards and pre-window results excluded.
No non-alert weekend item passed the significance and date-verification threshold; alerts were left to the alerts part.
The ternary-Goldbach formalization artifact predated the reporting window despite new commentary; no same-window item selected.
WenHai-E2E selected from abstract-level access; no quantitative skill claims reproduced without the full paper.
Enhancer-targeted CRISPR activation selected after methods/results review.
MOF radical-pair spin hyperpolarization selected; application claims bounded to demonstrated measurements.
Krypton-81 dating and mountain-thickness reconstruction selected; no palaeontology item passed the threshold.
Tirzepatide trial, eMTBR-tau243 biomarker and neurodevelopmental organoid study selected with cohort and translation limits.

access_gaps: Science Advances article pages returned access errors for the ocean-forecast and krypton-81 studies; only indexed abstracts were used for those stories.
The Science Advances quantum-code paper was supported by its abstract and the authors' RIKEN/JST technical summary, not an independent hardware replication.
Some NASA and Rubin archive pages were dynamically loaded and could not be exhaustively enumerated.
